manifest.name: Settings
manifest.description: Appearance, language, data and terminal preferences, and the settings of other plugins.

theme.label: Color theme
theme.help: Choose dark or light, or follow your operating system.

language.label: Language
language.help: Language of the user interface. Automatic follows your browser.

metricsSource.label: Metrics source
metricsSource.helpPrometheus: Where utilization series come from. Prometheus was found; it also provides network and filesystem metrics and a longer history.
metricsSource.helpPrometheusAt: Where utilization series come from. Prometheus was found at {{location}}; it also provides network and filesystem metrics and a longer history.
metricsSource.helpNoPrometheus: Where utilization series come from. Prometheus was not found in this cluster, so metrics-server is used and network and filesystem charts are unavailable.

metricsWindow.label: Metrics window
metricsWindow.help: How much utilization history charts show.

autoRefresh.label: Auto refresh
autoRefresh.help: Reload resource lists periodically. Off means manual refresh only.

liveUpdates.label: Live updates
liveUpdates.help: Refresh views as soon as the cluster changes. Resource types the server cannot watch are refreshed on a timer, at the auto refresh interval or every 30 seconds.

fontSize.label: Font size
fontSize.help: Font size of the terminal, exec and log views.

about.storage: Settings are stored in this browser.
